title: LAST PLACE: GERMANY
subtitle: Hours worked in a year by the average worker, 2023

lines.say: Who works the fewest hours in Europe? Not Spain. Not Italy.
Germany. The average German worker puts in 1,335 hours a year. A Greek worker, 1,893.
Why? Lots of part-time work, long holidays, and shorter weeks agreed with unions.
Croatia tops the list, at 1,974. All 31 countries are in our full video.
